SYNTHESIZED — no real omp transcript was available on this machine.

This fixture mimics the native shape of `<data_dir>/omp/agent/sessions/**/<session>.jsonl`
as written by omp: one JSON object per line with the same Pi-compatible record
shapes (`message` with `role`, `content`, `model`, `reasoning`, `usage`;
`tool_call` with `name` / `input`; `tool_result`; `subagent_start` /
`subagent_end`; `summary`), except the session version is reported as
`omp-<version>` (`omp-0.9.1` here) and omp-only record shapes may appear — this
fixture includes one `extension_state` record carrying an opaque `state` object.
The adapter maps such unmapped shapes to `system { text: <raw JSON> }` (never
dropped, never an error). Session ids, token counts, and prose are invented.
It is not a captured production transcript.
